   177→		throughput = incrRawMB / incDur.Seconds()
   178→	}
   179→
   180→	t.Logf("\n=== %s ===", t.Name())
   181→	t.Logf("  Base checkpoints:  %d", baseCheckpoints)
   182→	t.Logf("  Tier:              %s (real transcripts)", tierNameForSize(transcriptSize))
   183→	t.Logf("  Total raw:         %.1f MB (base)", float64(totalBytes)/(1024*1024))
   184→	t.Logf("  Total .git:        %d KB", totalKB)
   185→	t.Logf("  Seed duration:     %s (base)", seedDur.Round(time.Millisecond))
   186→	t.Logf("  GC duration:       %s (base)", gcDur.Round(time.Millisecond))
   187→	t.Logf("  Base push:         %s", basePushDur.Round(time.Millisecond))
   188→	t.Logf("  Incremental push:  %s (1 new × %s)", incDur.Round(time.Millisecond), formatBytes(incrBytes))
   189→	t.Logf("  Throughput:        %.1f MB/s (raw data / wall time)", throughput)
   190→}

   192→// --- Transcript source ---
   193→
   194→// blobRef is a reference to a transcript blob in the source repo.
   195→type blobRef struct {
   196→	hash plumbing.Hash
   197→	size int64
   198→}
   199→
   200→// transcriptSource provides real transcript data from the source repo's
   201→// entire/checkpoints/v1 branch, bucketed by size tier and loaded lazily.
   202→type transcriptSource struct {
   203→	repo  *gogit.Repository
   204→	tiers map[int][]blobRef // targetKey -> blob refs sorted by size
   205→}
   206→
   207→// newTranscriptSource scans the source repo's entire/checkpoints/v1 branch
   208→// and indexes all full.jsonl blobs by size tier.
   209→func newTranscriptSource(t *testing.T) *transcriptSource {
   210→	t.Helper()
   211→
   212→	// Find repo root.
   213→	out, err := exec.Command("git", "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel").Output()
   214→	if err != nil {
   215→		t.Fatalf("not in a git repo: %v", err)
   216→	}
   217→	repoRoot := strings.TrimSpace(string(out))
   218→
   219→	repo, err := gogit.PlainOpen(repoRoot)
   220→	if err != nil {
   221→		t.Fatalf("open source repo: %v", err)
   222→	}
   223→
   224→	// Resolve entire/checkpoints/v1 branch.
   225→	ref, err := repo.Reference(plumbing.ReferenceName("refs/heads/entire/checkpoints/v1"), true)
   226→	if err != nil {
   227→		t.Fatalf("entire/checkpoints/v1 branch not found (is this repo using Entire?): %v", err)
   228→	}
   229→
   230→	commit, err := repo.CommitObject(ref.Hash())
   231→	if err != nil {
   232→		t.Fatalf("resolve commit: %v", err)
   233→	}
   234→
   235→	tree, err := commit.Tree()
   236→	if err != nil {
   237→		t.Fatalf("resolve tree: %v", err)
   238→	}
   239→
   240→	// Scan tree for full.jsonl entries and bucket by size tier.
   241→	tiers := make(map[int][]blobRef)
   242→	err = tree.Files().ForEach(func(f *object.File) error {
   243→		if !strings.HasSuffix(f.Name, "full.jsonl") {
   244→			return nil
   245→		}
   246→		for _, tier := range sizeTiers {
   247→			if f.Size >= tier.minBytes && f.Size < tier.maxBytes {
   248→				tiers[tier.targetKey] = append(tiers[tier.targetKey], blobRef{hash: f.Hash, size: f.Size})
   249→				break
   250→			}
   251→		}
   252→		return nil
   253→	})
   254→	if err != nil {
   255→		t.Fatalf("scan tree: %v", err)
   256→	}
   257→
   258→	// Sort each tier by size for deterministic ordering.
   259→	for key := range tiers {
   260→		sort.Slice(tiers[key], func(i, j int) bool {
   261→			return tiers[key][i].size < tiers[key][j].size
   262→		})
   263→	}
   264→
   265→	// Log what we found.
   266→	for _, tier := range sizeTiers {
   267→		refs := tiers[tier.targetKey]
   268→		if len(refs) > 0 {
   269→			var totalSize int64
   270→			for _, r := range refs {
   271→				totalSize += r.size
   272→			}
   273→			t.Logf("  tier %-6s: %3d transcripts, avg %s", tier.name, len(refs), formatBytes(totalSize/int64(len(refs))))
   274→		}
   275→	}
   276→
   277→	return &transcriptSource{repo: repo, tiers: tiers}
   278→}
   279→
   280→// get returns the content of a real transcript blob for the given size tier and index.
   281→// Cycles through available blobs if index exceeds the pool size.
   282→func (s *transcriptSource) get(t *testing.T, targetSize, index int) []byte {
   283→	t.Helper()
   284→
   285→	refs, ok := s.tiers[targetSize]
   286→	if !ok || len(refs) == 0 {
   287→		t.Fatalf("no real transcripts available for tier %s", tierNameForSize(targetSize))
   288→	}
   289→
   290→	ref := refs[index%len(refs)]
   291→	blob, err := s.repo.BlobObject(ref.hash)
   292→	if err != nil {
   293→		t.Fatalf("read blob %s: %v", ref.hash, err)
   294→	}
   295→
   296→	reader, err := blob.Reader()
   297→	if err != nil {
   298→		t.Fatalf("blob reader %s: %v", ref.hash, err)
   299→	}
   300→	defer reader.Close()
   301→
   302→	content, err := io.ReadAll(reader)
   303→	if err != nil {
   304→		t.Fatalf("read blob content %s: %v", ref.hash, err)
   305→	}
   306→
   307→	return content
   308→}
   309→
   310→// tierNameForSize returns the human-readable tier name for a target size.
   311→func tierNameForSize(targetSize int) string {
   312→	for _, tier := range sizeTiers {
   313→		if tier.targetKey == targetSize {
   314→			return tier.name
   315→		}
   316→	}
   317→	return formatBytes(int64(targetSize))
   318→}

   320→// --- Checkpoint seeding ---
   321→
   322→// seedCheckpoints writes N checkpoints using real transcripts from the source repo.
   323→// Returns the seeding duration and total bytes written.
   324→func seedCheckpoints(t *testing.T, store *checkpoint.GitStore, src *transcriptSource, count, transcriptSize int) (time.Duration, int64) {
   325→	t.Helper()
   326→
   327→	ctx := context.Background()
   328→	start := time.Now()
   329→	var totalBytes int64
   330→
   331→	// Log progress for large scenarios.
   332→	logInterval := progressInterval(count, transcriptSize)
   333→
   334→	for i := range count {
   335→		if logInterval > 0 && i > 0 && i%logInterval == 0 {
   336→			t.Logf("  seeding: %d/%d checkpoints (%s elapsed)", i, count, time.Since(start).Round(time.Millisecond))
   337→		}
   338→
   339→		transcript := src.get(t, transcriptSize, i)
   340→		totalBytes += int64(len(transcript))
   341→
   342→		cpID, err := id.Generate()
   343→		if err != nil {
   344→			t.Fatalf("id.Generate: %v", err)
   345→		}
   346→		err = store.WriteCommitted(ctx, checkpoint.WriteCommittedOptions{
   347→			CheckpointID:     cpID,
   348→			SessionID:        fmt.Sprintf("perf-session-%d", i),
   349→			Agent:            agent.AgentTypeClaudeCode,
   350→			Transcript:       transcript,
   351→			Prompts:          []string{"Implement the feature"},
   352→			CheckpointsCount: 1,
   353→			AuthorName:       "Push Perf Test",
   354→			AuthorEmail:      "test@example.com",
   355→		})
   356→		if err != nil {
   357→			t.Fatalf("WriteCommitted checkpoint %d: %v", i, err)
   358→		}
   359→	}
   360→
   361→	return time.Since(start), totalBytes
   362→}
   363→
   364→// progressInterval returns how often to log seeding progress, or 0 to skip.
   365→func progressInterval(count, transcriptSize int) int {
   366→	totalBytes := int64(count) * int64(transcriptSize)
   367→	switch {
   368→	case totalBytes > 500*1024*1024: // >500MB total
   369→		return 5
   370→	case totalBytes > 100*1024*1024: // >100MB total
   371→		return 10
   372→	case totalBytes > 20*1024*1024: // >20MB total
   373→		return 25
   374→	default:
   375→		return 0 // no progress logging for small scenarios
   376→	}
   377→}

   479→// formatBytes returns a human-readable size string.
   480→func formatBytes(b int64) string {
   481→	switch {
   482→	case b >= 1024*1024:
   483→		return fmt.Sprintf("%.1f MB", float64(b)/(1024*1024))
   484→	case b >= 1024:
   485→		return fmt.Sprintf("%d KB", b/1024)
   486→	default:
   487→		return fmt.Sprintf("%d B", b)
   488→	}

   491→// measureRepoSize returns the loose object size, pack size, and total .git size in KB.
   492→func measureRepoSize(t *testing.T, dir string) (looseKB, packKB, totalKB int64) {
   493→	t.Helper()
   494→
   495→	// Parse git count-objects -v for loose/pack sizes.
   496→	cmd := exec.Command("git", "count-objects", "-v")
   497→	cmd.Dir = dir
   498→	out, err := cmd.Output()
   499→	if err != nil {
   500→		t.Fatalf("git count-objects: %v", err)
   501→	}
   502→
   503→	for _, line := range strings.Split(string(out), "\n") {
   504→		parts := strings.SplitN(line, ": ", 2)
   505→		if len(parts) != 2 {
   506→			continue
   507→		}
   508→		key := strings.TrimSpace(parts[0])
   509→		val := strings.TrimSpace(parts[1])
   510→		switch key {
   511→		case "size": // loose object size in KB
   512→			v, _ := strconv.ParseInt(val, 10, 64)
   513→			looseKB = v
   514→		case "size-pack": // pack size in KB
   515→			v, _ := strconv.ParseInt(val, 10, 64)
   516→			packKB = v
   517→		}
   518→	}
   519→
   520→	// Total .git directory size via du.
   521→	duCmd := exec.Command("du", "-sk", filepath.Join(dir, ".git"))
   522→	duOut, duErr := duCmd.Output()
   523→	if duErr == nil {
   524→		parts := strings.Fields(string(duOut))
   525→		if len(parts) > 0 {
   526→			v, _ := strconv.ParseInt(parts[0], 10, 64)
   527→			totalKB = v
   528→		}
   529→	}
   530→
   531→	return looseKB, packKB, totalKB
   532→}

   547→// doTimedPush runs a git push command and returns its wall-clock duration.
   548→func doTimedPush(t *testing.T, dir string, args ...string) time.Duration {
   549→	t.Helper()
   550→
   551→	var stderr bytes.Buffer
   552→	cmd := exec.Command(args[0], args[1:]...)
   553→	cmd.Dir = dir
   554→	cmd.Stderr = &stderr
   555→
   556→	start := time.Now()
   557→	err := cmd.Run()
   558→	dur := time.Since(start)
   559→
   560→	if err != nil {
   561→		t.Fatalf("git push failed (%s): %v\n%s", dur, err, stderr.String())
   562→	}
   563→
   564→	return dur
   565→}

   574→
   575→// pushProfileResult holds the detailed timing breakdown of a git push.

   596→
   597→// TestPushProfile runs a small number of scenarios with detailed push timing
   598→// breakdown using GIT_TRACE2_EVENT to identify where time is spent.
   599→//
   600→// Run with: go test -v -run TestPushProfile -tags pushperf -timeout 10m ./cmd/entire/cli/checkpoint/
   601→func TestPushProfile(t *testing.T) {
   602→	fullName := perfTestRepoOwner + "/" + perfTestRepoName
   603→	src := newTranscriptSource(t)
   604→	repoURL := createTempGitHubRepo(t, fullName)
   605→	t.Cleanup(func() { deleteTempGitHubRepo(t, fullName) })
   606→
   607→	type scenario struct {
   608→		name           string
   609→		checkpoints    int
   610→		transcriptSize int
   611→	}
   612→
   613→	firstPush := []scenario{
   614→		{"10cp_100KB", 10, 100 * 1024},
   615→		{"50cp_500KB", 50, 500 * 1024},
   616→		{"50cp_2500KB", 50, 2500 * 1024},
   617→		{"100cp_2500KB", 100, 2500 * 1024},
   618→		{"200cp_2500KB", 200, 2500 * 1024},
   619→		{"50cp_10MB", 50, 10 * 1024 * 1024},
   620→		{"10cp_50MB", 10, 50 * 1024 * 1024},
   621→	}
   622→
   623→	incremental := []scenario{
   624→		{"50cp_base_500KB", 50, 500 * 1024},
   625→		{"50cp_base_2500KB", 50, 2500 * 1024},
   626→		{"200cp_base_2500KB", 200, 2500 * 1024},
   627→		{"50cp_base_10MB", 50, 10 * 1024 * 1024},
   628→	}
   629→
   630→	var results []profileResult
   631→
   632→	for _, sc := range firstPush {
   633→		t.Run("FirstPush/"+sc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
   634→			dir := t.TempDir()
   635→			repo := initLocalRepo(t, dir)
   636→			store := checkpoint.NewGitStore(repo)
   637→
   638→			seedDur, totalBytes := seedCheckpoints(t, store, src, sc.checkpoints, sc.transcriptSize)
   639→			gcDur := timeGitGC(t, dir)
   640→			_, pk, _ := measureRepoSize(t, dir)
   641→			addRemote(t, dir, repoURL)
   642→
   643→			profile := profiledForcePush(t, dir, "origin", "entire/checkpoints/v1")
   644→
   645→			t.Logf("  Seed: %s, GC: %s", seedDur.Round(time.Millisecond), gcDur.Round(time.Millisecond))
   646→			logPushProfile(t, profile)
   647→
   648→			r := buildResult("FirstPush/"+sc.name, float64(totalBytes)/(1024*1024), pk, profile)
   649→			results = append(results, r)
   650→		})
   651→	}
   652→
   653→	for _, sc := range incremental {
   654→		t.Run("Incremental/"+sc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
   655→			dir := t.TempDir()
   656→			repo := initLocalRepo(t, dir)
   657→			store := checkpoint.NewGitStore(repo)
   658→
   659→			// Seed and push baseline.
   660→			_, _ = seedCheckpoints(t, store, src, sc.checkpoints, sc.transcriptSize)
   661→			timeGitGC(t, dir)
   662→			addRemote(t, dir, repoURL)
   663→			timeForcePush(t, dir, "origin", "entire/checkpoints/v1")
   664→
   665→			// Reopen repo after GC.
   666→			repo, err := gogit.PlainOpen(dir)
   667→			if err != nil {
   668→				t.Fatalf("PlainOpen after gc: %v", err)
   669→			}
   670→			store = checkpoint.NewGitStore(repo)
   671→
   672→			// Add 1 more checkpoint and profile the incremental push.
   673→			_, incrBytes := seedCheckpoints(t, store, src, 1, sc.transcriptSize)
   674→			timeGitGC(t, dir)
   675→			_, pk, _ := measureRepoSize(t, dir)
   676→
   677→			profile := profiledPush(t, dir, "origin", "entire/checkpoints/v1")
   678→
   679→			logPushProfile(t, profile)
   680→
   681→			r := buildResult("Incremental/"+sc.name, float64(incrBytes)/(1024*1024), pk, profile)
   682→			results = append(results, r)
   683→		})
   684→	}
   685→
   686→	// Print final summary table.
   687→	t.Logf("\n\n========== PUSH PROFILE SUMMARY TABLE ==========")
   688→	t.Logf("%-30s | %8s | %8s | %10s | %10s | %10s | %10s | %10s",
   689→		"Scenario", "Raw MB", "Pack KB", "Negotiate", "Pack+Send", "Remote", "Overhead", "TOTAL")
   690→	t.Logf("%s", strings.Repeat("-", 120))
   691→	for _, r := range results {
   692→		t.Logf("%-30s | %8.1f | %8d | %10s | %10s | %10s | %10s | %10s",
   693→			r.scenario, r.rawMB, r.packKB,
   694→			r.negotiate.Round(time.Millisecond),
   695→			r.packSend.Round(time.Millisecond),
   696→			r.remoteProc.Round(time.Millisecond),
   697→			r.overhead.Round(time.Millisecond),
   698→			r.totalPush.Round(time.Millisecond))
   699→	}
   700→	t.Logf("%s", strings.Repeat("-", 120))
   701→}
   702→
   703→// profileResult holds aggregated push phase timings for a single scenario.
   704→type profileResult struct {
   705→	scenario   string
   706→	rawMB      float64
   707→	packKB     int64
   708→	negotiate  time.Duration
   709→	packSend   time.Duration
   710→	remoteProc time.Duration
   711→	overhead   time.Duration
   712→	totalPush  time.Duration
   713→}
   714→
   715→// buildResult extracts the key phase durations from a push profile.
   716→func buildResult(name string, rawMB float64, packKB int64, profile pushProfileResult) profileResult {
   717→	var negotiate, packSend, remoteProc time.Duration
   718→	for _, p := range profile.phases {
   719→		n := strings.TrimSpace(p.name)
   720→		switch n {
   721→		case "transport_push/get_refs_list":
   722→			negotiate = p.duration
   723→		case "send_pack/pack_objects":
   724→			packSend = p.duration
   725→		case "send_pack/receive_status":
   726→			remoteProc = p.duration

   745→// profiledForcePush runs a force push with GIT_TRACE2_EVENT tracing enabled.
   746→func profiledForcePush(t *testing.T, dir, remote, branch string) pushProfileResult {

   751→// doProfiledPush runs a git push with GIT_TRACE2_EVENT tracing and returns the profile.
   752→func doProfiledPush(t *testing.T, dir string, args ...string) pushProfileResult {
   753→	t.Helper()
   754→
   755→	traceDir := t.TempDir()
   756→	traceFile := filepath.Join(traceDir, "trace2.jsonl")
   757→
   758→	var stderr bytes.Buffer
   759→	//nolint:gosec // test-only, args are test constants
   760→	cmd := exec.Command(args[0], args[1:]...)
   761→	cmd.Dir = dir
   762→	cmd.Stderr = &stderr
   763→	cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(),
   764→		"GIT_TRACE2_EVENT="+traceFile,
   765→	)
   766→
   767→	start := time.Now()
   768→	err := cmd.Run()
   769→	total := time.Since(start)
   770→
   771→	if err != nil {
   772→		t.Fatalf("profiled push failed (%s): %v\n%s", total, err, stderr.String())
   773→	}
   774→
   775→	traceData, err := os.ReadFile(traceFile)
   776→	if err != nil {
   777→		t.Logf("warning: could not read trace file: %v", err)
   778→		return pushProfileResult{total: total, progressOutput: stderr.String()}
   779→	}
   780→
   781→	phases := parseTrace2Phases(t, traceData)
   782→
   783→	return pushProfileResult{
   784→		total:          total,
   785→		phases:         phases,
   786→		progressOutput: stderr.String(),
   787→	}
   788→}

   790→// profiledPush runs a regular (non-force) push with GIT_TRACE2_EVENT tracing.
   791→func profiledPush(t *testing.T, dir, remote, branch string) pushProfileResult {
   792→	t.Helper()
   793→	return doProfiledPush(t, dir, "git", "push", "--progress", remote, "refs/heads/"+branch)
   794→}

   796→// parseTrace2Phases extracts timing phases from GIT_TRACE2_EVENT JSON lines.
   797→// Returns two slices: a clean summary of the main push phases and a detailed
   798→// breakdown of all significant trace events.
   799→func parseTrace2Phases(t *testing.T, data []byte) []pushPhase {
   800→	t.Helper()
   801→
   802→	var phases []pushPhase
   803→	childArgv := make(map[int][]string)
   804→
   805→	for _, line := range bytes.Split(data, []byte("\n")) {
   806→		if len(line) == 0 {
   807→			continue
   808→		}
   809→		var ev trace2Event
   810→		if err := json.Unmarshal(line, &ev); err != nil {
   811→			continue
   812→		}
   813→
   814→		switch ev.Event {
   815→		case "child_start":
   816→			childArgv[ev.ChildID] = ev.Argv
   817→
   818→		case "child_exit":
   819→			if ev.TRel < 0.001 {
   820→				continue
   821→			}
   822→			name := childLabel(childArgv[ev.ChildID])
   823→			dur := time.Duration(ev.TRel * float64(time.Second))
   824→			phases = append(phases, pushPhase{name: name, duration: dur})
   825→
   826→		case "region_leave":
   827→			if ev.TRel < 0.001 {
   828→				continue
   829→			}
   830→			name := ev.Category
   831→			if ev.Label != "" {
   832→				name += "/" + ev.Label
   833→			}
   834→			indent := strings.Repeat("  ", ev.Nesting)
   835→			dur := time.Duration(ev.TRel * float64(time.Second))
   836→			phases = append(phases, pushPhase{name: indent + name, duration: dur})
   837→		}
   838→	}
   839→
   840→	return phases
   841→}

   843→// logPushProfile logs a clean summary of push phases followed by the detailed trace.
   844→func logPushProfile(t *testing.T, profile pushProfileResult) {
   845→	t.Helper()
   846→
   847→	// Extract key durations from the detailed phases.
   848→	var negotiate, packObjects, receiveStatus time.Duration
   849→	for _, p := range profile.phases {
   850→		name := strings.TrimSpace(p.name)
   851→		switch name {
   852→		case "transport_push/get_refs_list":
   853→			negotiate = p.duration
   854→		case "send_pack/pack_objects":
   855→			packObjects = p.duration
   856→		case "send_pack/receive_status":
   857→			receiveStatus = p.duration
   858→		}
   859→	}
   860→
   861→	overhead := profile.total - negotiate - packObjects - receiveStatus
   862→	if overhead < 0 {
   863→		overhead = 0
   864→	}
   865→
   866→	t.Logf("  --- Push Summary ---")
   867→	t.Logf("  Total push wall time: %s", profile.total.Round(time.Millisecond))
   868→	t.Logf("")
   869→	logPhase := func(label string, d time.Duration) {
   870→		pct := float64(d) / float64(profile.total) * 100
   871→		t.Logf("    %-30s %10s  (%5.1f%%)", label, d.Round(time.Millisecond), pct)
   872→	}
   873→	logPhase("Ref negotiation (HTTPS)", negotiate)
   874→	logPhase("Pack + send objects", packObjects)
   875→	logPhase("Remote processing", receiveStatus)
   876→	logPhase("Overhead", overhead)
   877→
   878→	t.Logf("")
   879→	t.Logf("  --- Detailed Trace ---")
   880→	for _, p := range profile.phases {
   881→		pct := float64(p.duration) / float64(profile.total) * 100
   882→		t.Logf("    %-40s %10s  (%5.1f%%)", p.name, p.duration.Round(time.Millisecond), pct)
   883→	}
   884→}
   885→
   886→// childLabel produces a human-readable label from a child process argv.
   887→func childLabel(argv []string) string {
   888→	if len(argv) == 0 {
   889→		return "child: unknown"
   890→	}
   891→	base := filepath.Base(argv[0])
   892→	// Identify well-known git subprocesses.
   893→	switch {
   894→	case strings.Contains(base, "credential"):
   895→		return "child: credential-helper"
   896→	case strings.Contains(base, "remote-https"):
   897→		return "child: git-remote-https"
   898→	case base == "git" && len(argv) > 1:
   899→		return "child: git " + argv[1]
   900→	default:
   901→		// Use first 2 non-flag args.
   902→		var parts []string
   903→		for _, arg := range argv {
   904→			if strings.HasPrefix(arg, "-") {
   905→				break
   906→			}
   907→			parts = append(parts, filepath.Base(arg))
   908→		}
   909→		if len(parts) > 0 {
   910→			return "child: " + strings.Join(parts, " ")
   911→		}
   912→		return "child: " + base
   913→	}
   914→}
   915→
